title: Mamdani Derangement Syndrome: Murdoch Media Lets Its Islamophobic Flag Fly
author: Justin Baragona
content:
Good evening, and welcome to this week's** 'Ragebait.'**

**Justin Baragona** here, bringing you the latest media dispatches from the
right-wing industrial outrage complex and Bari World. In tonight's edition, we
look at how the Murdoch media empire is leaning harder into Islamophobia as it
ramps up its fearmongering about Zohran Mamdani. Plus, CBS News staff isn't
sold on Bari Weiss's newest '60 Minutes' hires, and the network's ratings
under Weiss keep sinking lower and lower.

# 'Incredibly Islamophobic Image'

York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani speaks during a primary-night watch party for
NYC congressional candidate Claire Valdez in Brooklyn on June 23, 2026. Photo
by Michael M. Santiago/Getty Images_

Since [even before](https://www.mediamatters.org/diversity-
discrimination/right-wing-media-ramp-anti-muslim-attacks-zohran-mamdani-final-
days-nyc)**** he became New York mayor last year, the right-wing infotainment
complex - and, particularly, the [media
outlets](https://www.thenation.com/article/politics/zohran-mamdani-new-york-
mayor-conservative-attacks-political-opposition-media-new-york-post/) owned by
**Rupert Murdoch** - has obsessively attacked **Zohran Mamdani** , painting
the democratic socialist as a dangerous
"[antisemite](https://www.mediaite.com/media/fox-news-host-rages-at-mamandi-
win-i-look-forward-to-him-totally-failing/)" who will [destroy the
city](https://www.mediamatters.org/fox-news/ny-post-columnist-miranda-devine-
mamdani-targeting-negligent-landlords-communist) with his
["communist"](https://www.mediamatters.org/fox-news/ny-post-columnist-miranda-
devine-mamdani-targeting-negligent-landlords-communist) policies while
[calling for him](https://www.mediamatters.org/diversity-discrimination/nyc-
mayoral-election-approaches-right-wing-media-back-gop-push) to be
denaturalized and deported.

And while there's [always](https://www.mediamatters.org/fox-news/fox-news-
will-cain-calls-zohran-mamdani-threat-western-civilization) been a [consistent
undercurrent](https://www.mediamatters.org/fox-news/fox-news-raymond-arroyo-
suggests-zohran-mamdani-will-begin-quoting-mohamed-atta) of
[Islamophobia](https://www.mediamatters.org/fox-news/fox-news-host-calls-
zohran-mamdani-kind-che-guevara-islamist) flowing through this
[unending](https://www.mediamatters.org/fox-news/fox-news-will-cain-zohran-
mamdani-hiding-ball-little-bit-how-he-feels-about-islam-and-its) and
[deranged](https://www.mediamatters.org/fox-news/foxs-deranged-reaction-nyc-
mayor-mamdanis-affordable-housing-proposal) demonization of Mamdani, the last
week has brought forth a more overt stream of anti-Muslim hate that has blared
on the front pages of Murdoch's papers and the screens of cable news.
